response.query: Will we include grey literature (theses, clinical reports, non-indexed books)? If yes, how will these be sourced, tagged, and distinguished from indexed studies?
response.answer: Yes, grey literature will be included. Sources will be identified via institutional repositories and specialized databases. They will be tagged and distinguished from indexed studies by metadata.
